svg.title: Polynomial integration screening pack stops
svg.desc: Recorded stopping steps: answer-only PART26000, scratchpad PART5500, answer-only TRAIN14500, scratchpad TRAIN27000. Three seeds per screening cell. These are stopping points, not seed means or the final ten-seed results. Only scratchpad PART scores 1.0 on withheld fractions. No full gcd/division mechanism is verified.

g.text: Polynomial integration: where the scratchpad helps
Three-seed screening packs: stopping steps after all seeds reached exact saved-test output
These are recorded pack stops, not averages or each seed's first-exact step.
Only scratchpad PART was exact on withheld fractions (1.0); TRAIN was not.
The learned integration circuit remains partial: no gcd/division closed form or complement certificate.
